scenes.headline: Guessed $86 - Actually Paying $273
scenes.stat_label: REAL RECURRING SPEND VS $86 MEMORY GUESS
bullets: Most households guess they spend under $100 on subscriptions
Bank audits reveal the real average sits above $270 a month
scenes.narration: When researchers asked consumers to estimate their monthly subscription bill, the average guess was eighty-six dollars. Their real bank statements showed two hundred seventy-three.

scenes.headline: MIT & Carnegie Mellon 'Pain of Paying' Scans
scenes.stat_label: CASH LIGHTS UP THE INSULA PAIN CENTER
bullets: Counting physical bills triggers natural neural braking
Auto-billing hides the transaction until memory forgets it
scenes.narration: Brain-imaging researchers at MIT and Carnegie Mellon discovered why. Handing over physical cash activates the insula - the brain center that registers pain. Frictionless auto-renewals numb that natural alarm completely.
